title: Unit tests: base layer
brief: Pest unit tests for repositories, DTOs, query kit, enums, exception format.

title: Unit tests: auth and RBAC
brief: Unit tests for auth services, OTP, authorization service, user status guard.

title: Unit tests: content
brief: Unit tests for articles, slug generator, comments, products, contacts, analytics, settings services.

title: Feature tests: auth
brief: Feature tests: register, login, logout, OTP reset, blocked users.

title: Feature tests: RBAC
brief: Feature tests: multi-role user, permission denial per role, role assignment, user status change.

title: Feature tests: content
brief: Feature tests: article workflow and ownership, nested comments, products CRUD authorization, query filtering, search, sort, pagination.

title: Style and static checks
brief: Run pint, route:list, migrate:status, composer validate; fix style issues.

title: Security review
brief: Review authorization on every route, uploads, rate limits, secret exposure, soft-delete leakage; write docs/security-findings.md.

title: E2E with Playwright, one test user per role
brief: Fill tests/e2e/access-matrix.json (every route x every role, including guest) and add Playwright specs for the main journeys per role: sign in, create/edit/delete content, the pages each role must NOT open. The scaffold (playwright.config.ts, fixtures.ts, E2eUsersSeeder) already exists; extend it, do not recreate it.
